items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And Oscar Peterson called me to go with him, and I said, no, I can't do it because Nat is ill

ctx.x: regretted leaving and going to Nat because we had started rehearsing and getting some harmonic things together that was very, very nice, you know. But I left again and tried to follow the money, which with Nat I never regretted working with Nat because Nat was -- it was just a pleasure working with him. Because in his way he was a giant also. You know.

But I think musically I would have continued to expand more, you know, being with Art, and I regretted that. And another thing that I've often wondered about is Nat was in the hospital. We had appeared at Carnegie Hall and he had an attack, and he had to have an operation for ulcers. And Oscar Peterson called me to go with him, and I said, no, I can't do it because Nat is ill and I wouldn't want to leave while he's ill, and Oscar called me two or three times. So I didn't go, Herb Ellis went with him, you know. So…
You mentioned also very, very briefly Fats Waller and a 16 piece band?
